# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
"""Text forms a reading's ledger row and token cells share (OMN-22897).

The stamp form and the cell-safe reason token belong to no single node: the reading compute node and
the nodes that keep a reading in the ledger all write the same forms, so they live here rather than in
one node's handler package.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
from datetime import UTC, datetime

_TOKEN_LIMIT = 120
_NOT_TOKEN = re.compile(r"[^a-z0-9]+")


def stamp_text(moment: datetime) -> str:
    """The ledger's stamp form, UTC to the second."""
    return moment.astimezone(UTC).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")


def reason_token(text: str) -> str:
    """A free-text reason as one cell-safe token."""
    return _NOT_TOKEN.sub("-", text.lower()).strip("-")[:_TOKEN_LIMIT] or "unspecified"


__all__ = ["reason_token", "stamp_text"]

"""Typed models of the reading: a verdict computed from ledger rows in a closed window.

Shared by node_reading_compute (the pure function) and node_reading_writer_effect (the only
writer of reading rows), so neither imports the other's package.

A reading is WORKING, NOT_WORKING or UNKNOWN. The row word for NOT_WORKING has an underscore
so that a row cell stays one token; the displayed words are WORKING, NOT WORKING and UNKNOWN.
UNKNOWN and stale count as NOT WORKING for anything that gates on a reading (``blocks``).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime
from enum import StrEnum
from typing import Literal

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field, model_validator


class EnumReadingVerdict(StrEnum):
    WORKING = "WORKING"
    NOT_WORKING = "NOT_WORKING"
    UNKNOWN = "UNKNOWN"

    @property
    def display(self) -> str:
        return self.value.replace("_", " ")

    @property
    def blocks(self) -> bool:
        """Anything but WORKING blocks the pieces above this one."""
        return self is not EnumReadingVerdict.WORKING


class EnumReadingOutcome(StrEnum):
    """How a reading row came to be.

    ``read`` and ``window-failed`` are computed readings and are immutable under their row key.
    ``source-unreadable`` and ``replay-failed`` are records of an attempt and are not.
    """

    READ = "read"
    WINDOW_FAILED = "window-failed"
    SOURCE_UNREADABLE = "source-unreadable"
    REPLAY_FAILED = "replay-failed"

    @property
    def is_computed(self) -> bool:
        return self in (EnumReadingOutcome.READ, EnumReadingOutcome.WINDOW_FAILED)


class ModelLedgerEvidenceRow(BaseModel):
    """One ledger row as evidence: its stamp, type, cells and exact text."""

    model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True, extra="forbid")

    stamp: datetime
    row_type: str
    lane: str | None = None
    cells: dict[str, str] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    raw: str
    ingested_at: datetime | None = None

    @property
    def key(self) -> str:
        """The row's identity: its ``req`` cell, else its stamp, type and lane."""
        request = self.cells.get("req")
        if request:
            return f"req:{request}"
        return f"row:{self.stamp.isoformat()}|{self.row_type}|{self.lane or ''}"


class EnumCellOp(StrEnum):
    EQ = "eq"
    NE = "ne"
    IN = "in"


class ModelCellPredicate(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True, extra="forbid")

    cell: str = Field(min_length=1)
    op: EnumCellOp
    value: str | None = None
    values: tuple[str, ...] = ()

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def _shape(self) -> ModelCellPredicate:
        if self.op is EnumCellOp.IN:
            if not self.values or self.value is not None:
                raise ValueError("op in takes values and no value")
        elif self.value is None or self.values:
            raise ValueError(f"op {self.op.value} takes one value")
        return self

    def holds(self, cells: dict[str, str]) -> bool:
        found = cells.get(self.cell)
        if self.op is EnumCellOp.EQ:
            return found == self.value
        if self.op is EnumCellOp.NE:
            return found is not None and found != self.value
        return found in self.values

class ModelReadingSource(BaseModel):
    """One ledger source of a piece's reading: which rows, when they pass, and when the

    def selects(self, row: ModelLedgerEvidenceRow) -> bool:

        if self.lane is not None and row.lane != self.lane:

        if self.term is not None and self.term not in row.raw:

# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 OmniNode.ai Inc.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
"""Typed request and reading of the runner-group exposure read.

The request carries facts a fetching effect already read (the org group settings, the
workflow files that select the group's labels, the jobs queued or running on the group) and
the settings from the overlay (which events count as public-origin, how old a read may be).
The reading is one verdict per subject and one overall verdict. Nothing here reads a clock
or a network.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime
from enum import StrEnum

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field

from omnimarket.models.model_reading import EnumReadingVerdict


class EnumExposureReadFailure(StrEnum):
    """Why the fetching effect could not read the group; every one reads UNKNOWN."""

    ORG_READ_DENIED = "org-read-denied"
    BUDGET_EXHAUSTED = "budget-exhausted"
    UNREADABLE = "unreadable"
    TOKEN_MINT_FAILED = "token-mint-failed"
    #: The write node, asked over the bus for the group, did not answer (no bus, no consumer, no terminal).
    WRITE_NODE_UNAVAILABLE = "write-node-unavailable"
    #: The write node answered with a refusal (an overlay that does not name the group, an older node).

# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 OmniNode.ai Inc.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
"""The real group source: reads one runner group through the GitHub REST API.

Every call is counted against the overlay's ``max_calls``; the call past it is not made and the read
ends in ``budget-exhausted``. Reads only (GET). The token comes from the environment variable the
overlay names, at call time, or — when the overlay declares ``token_mint`` — is minted once per
source instance from the named secrets; it is never put in a result, an error or a log line.

Reading rules, all conservative so that an unreadable fact reads UNKNOWN and never WORKING:
- a job selects the group when its ``runs-on`` (string, list or ``labels``) names a group label, or
  holds an expression (``${{ ... }}``) the probe cannot resolve, or calls a reusable workflow that does;
- a reusable workflow that cannot be read ends the read in ``unreadable``.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import base64
import binascii
import json
from collections.abc import Mapping
from datetime import datetime
from typing import Any
from uuid import UUID

import yaml

from omnimarket.models.runner_group_exposure import (
    EnumExposureReadFailure,
    ModelGroupJob,
    ModelGroupWorkflowFile,
    ModelRunnerGroupFacts,
)
from omnimarket.nodes.node_runner_group_exposure_effect.adapters.write_node_group_reader import (
    GroupReadError,
    WriteNodeGroupReader,
)
from omnimarket.nodes.node_runner_group_exposure_effect.models.model_exposure_probe import (
    ModelGroupRead,
)
from omnimarket.nodes.node_runner_group_exposure_effect.overlay import (
    ModelGithubSource,
)
from omnimarket.nodes.node_runner_group_exposure_effect.protocols.protocol_group_source import (
    ProtocolHttpGet,
    ProtocolTokenMint,
)

_DENIED = (401, 403, 404)
_RUN_STATUSES = ("queued", "in_progress")


class _StopError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, failure: EnumExposureReadFailure) -> None:
        super().__init__(failure.value)
        self.failure = failure


class GithubGroupSource:
    def __init__(
        self,
        settings: ModelGithubSource,
        http_get: ProtocolHttpGet,
        environ: Mapping[str, str],
        token_mint: ProtocolTokenMint | None = None,
        group_reader: WriteNodeGroupReader | None = None,
        correlation_id: UUID | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        if settings.token_mint is not None and token_mint is None:
            raise ValueError(
                "the overlay declares token_mint, but no token minter was injected"
            )
        if settings.group_read is not None and (
            group_reader is None or correlation_id is None
        ):
            raise ValueError(
                "the overlay declares group_read, but no group reader was injected"
            )
        self._group_reader = group_reader
        self._correlation_id = correlation_id
        self._s = settings
        self._http = http_get
        self._environ = environ
        self._mint = token_mint
        self._minted: str | None = None
        self._calls = 0
        self._missing_permission: str | None = None

    def _token(self) -> str:
        """The read's bearer token: minted once per instance, or read from the environment."""
        if self._s.token_mint is None:
            return self._environ.get(self._s.token_env, "")
        if self._minted is None:
            mint = self._s.token_mint
            if self._mint is None:
                raise _StopError(EnumExposureReadFailure.TOKEN_MINT_FAILED)
            try:
                self._minted = self._mint.mint(
                    org=mint.org,
                    app_id_secret=mint.app_id_secret,
                    private_key_secret=mint.private_key_secret,
                )
            except Exception as error:
                raise _StopError(EnumExposureReadFailure.TOKEN_MINT_FAILED) from error
        return self._minted

    # -- transport -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _get(self, path: str, *, denied_is_org: bool = False) -> Any:
        if self._calls >= self._s.max_calls:
            raise _StopError(EnumExposureReadFailure.BUDGET_EXHAUSTED)
        token = self._token()
        if not token:
            raise _StopError(EnumExposureReadFailure.ORG_READ_DENIED)
        self._calls += 1
        status, body = self._http.get(
            f"{self._s.api_base.rstrip('/')}{path}",
            {
                "Authorization": f"Bearer {token}",
                "Accept": "application/vnd.github+json",
            },
            self._s.timeout_seconds,
        )
        if status in _DENIED and denied_is_org:
            self._missing_permission = self._s.org_read_permission
            raise _StopError(EnumExposureReadFailure.ORG_READ_DENIED)
        if status != 200:
            raise _StopError(EnumExposureReadFailure.UNREADABLE)
        try:
            return json.loads(body)
        except ValueError as error:
            raise _StopError(EnumExposureReadFailure.UNREADABLE) from error

    def _optional(self, path: str) -> Any | None:
        """A GET whose 404 means the thing is absent (a repository with no workflows)."""
        if self._calls >= self._s.max_calls:
            raise _StopError(EnumExposureReadFailure.BUDGET_EXHAUSTED)
        token = self._token()
        if not token:
            raise _StopError(EnumExposureReadFailure.ORG_READ_DENIED)
        self._calls += 1
        status, body = self._http.get(
            f"{self._s.api_base.rstrip('/')}{path}",
            {
                "Authorization": f"Bearer {token}",
                "Accept": "application/vnd.github+json",
            },
            self._s.timeout_seconds,
        )
        if status == 404:
            return None
        if status != 200:
            raise _StopError(EnumExposureReadFailure.UNREADABLE)
        try:
            return json.loads(body)
        except ValueError as error:
            raise _StopError(EnumExposureReadFailure.UNREADABLE) from error

    # -- parsing -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _document(self, repository: str, path: str, ref: str | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
        query = f"?ref={ref}" if ref else ""
        meta = self._get(f"/repos/{repository}/contents/{path}{query}")
        try:
            text = base64.b64decode(meta["content"]).decode("utf-8")
            loaded = yaml.safe_load(text)
        except (
            KeyError,
            TypeError,
            ValueError,
            binascii.Error,
            yaml.YAMLError,
        ) as error:
            raise _StopError(EnumExposureReadFailure.UNREADABLE) from error
        if not isinstance(loaded, dict):
            raise _StopError(EnumExposureReadFailure.UNREADABLE)
        return loaded

    @staticmethod
    def _triggers(document: Mapping[Any, Any]) -> tuple[str, ...]:
        # YAML 1.1 reads the key ``on`` as the boolean True.
        raw = document.get("on", document.get(True))
        if isinstance(raw, str):
            return (raw,)
        if isinstance(raw, list):
            return tuple(str(item) for item in raw)
        if isinstance(raw, dict):
            return tuple(str(key) for key in raw)
        return ()

    def _runs_on_selects(self, runs_on: object) -> bool:
        labels = set(self._s.group_labels)
        if isinstance(runs_on, str):
            return "${{" in runs_on or runs_on in labels
        if isinstance(runs_on, list):
            return any(self._runs_on_selects(item) for item in runs_on)
        if isinstance(runs_on, dict):
            return any(
                self._runs_on_selects(runs_on[key])
                for key in ("labels", "group")
                if key in runs_on
            )
        return False

    def _selects(
        self, repository: str, document: Mapping[Any, Any], depth: int = 0
    ) -> bool:
        jobs = document.get("jobs")
        if not isinstance(jobs, dict):
            return False
        for job in jobs.values():
            if not isinstance(job, dict):
                continue
            if self._runs_on_selects(job.get("runs-on")):
                return True
            uses = job.get("uses")
            if (
                isinstance(uses, str)
                and depth < 3
                and self._uses_selects(repository, uses, depth)
            ):
                return True
        return False

    def _uses_selects(self, repository: str, uses: str, depth: int) -> bool:
        target, _, ref = uses.partition("@")
        if target.startswith("./"):
            document = self._document(repository, target[2:], None)
            return self._selects(repository, document, depth + 1)
        parts = target.split("/", 2)
        if len(parts) != 3 or not ref:
            raise _StopError(EnumExposureReadFailure.UNREADABLE)
        document = self._document(f"{parts[0]}/{parts[1]}", parts[2], ref)
        return self._selects(f"{parts[0]}/{parts[1]}", document, depth + 1)

    # -- the read ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def read(self, *, now: datetime) -> ModelGroupRead:
        try:
            group, repositories = self._group()
            files = self._files(repositories)
            jobs = self._jobs(repositories, files)
        except _StopError as stop:
            return ModelGroupRead(
                read_at=now,
                calls=self._calls,
                read_failure=stop.failure,
                missing_permission=self._missing_permission,
            )
        return ModelGroupRead(
            group=group, files=files, jobs=jobs, read_at=now, calls=self._calls
        )

    def _group_via_write_node(
        self, reader: WriteNodeGroupReader, correlation_id: UUID
    ) -> tuple[ModelRunnerGroupFacts, tuple[str, ...]]:
        """The group's settings and repositories from the write node over the bus.

        One bus call counts as one call of the budget. No organization call is made with this
        source's own token, and no token is minted for it.
        """
        if self._calls >= self._s.max_calls:
            raise _StopError(EnumExposureReadFailure.BUDGET_EXHAUSTED)
        self._calls += 1
        try:
            facts = reader.read(
                org=self._s.org,
                group_id=self._s.group_id,
                correlation_id=correlation_id,
            )
        except GroupReadError as error:
            if error.failure is EnumExposureReadFailure.ORG_READ_DENIED:
                self._missing_permission = self._s.org_read_permission
            raise _StopError(error.failure) from error
        return facts, facts.repositories

    def _group(self) -> tuple[ModelRunnerGroupFacts, tuple[str, ...]]:
        if self._group_reader is not None and self._correlation_id is not None:
            return self._group_via_write_node(self._group_reader, self._correlation_id)
        base = f"/orgs/{self._s.org}/actions/runner-groups/{self._s.group_id}"
        meta = self._get(base, denied_is_org=True)
        listing = self._get(f"{base}/repositories", denied_is_org=True)
        try:
            repositories = tuple(str(r["full_name"]) for r in listing["repositories"])
            facts = ModelRunnerGroupFacts(
                group_id=self._s.group_id,
                allows_public_repositories=bool(meta["allows_public_repositories"]),
                restricted_to_workflows=bool(meta["restricted_to_selected_workflows"]),
                selected_workflows=tuple(
                    str(w) for w in meta.get("selected_workflows") or ()
                ),
                repositories=repositories,
            )
        except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError) as error:
            raise _StopError(EnumExposureReadFailure.UNREADABLE) from error
        return facts, repositories

    def _files(
        self, repositories: tuple[str, ...]
    ) -> tuple[ModelGroupWorkflowFile, ...]:
        files: list[ModelGroupWorkflowFile] = []
        for repository in repositories:
            branch = self._get(f"/repos/{repository}")
            try:
                ref = str(branch["default_branch"])
            except (KeyError, TypeError) as error:
                raise _StopError(EnumExposureReadFailure.UNREADABLE) from error
            listing = self._optional(
                f"/repos/{repository}/contents/.github/workflows?ref={ref}"
            )
            if listing is None:
                continue
            if not isinstance(listing, list):
                raise _StopError(EnumExposureReadFailure.UNREADABLE)
            for entry in listing:
                try:
                    path = str(entry["path"])
                    kind = str(entry["type"])
                except (KeyError, TypeError) as error:
                    raise _StopError(EnumExposureReadFailure.UNREADABLE) from error
                if kind != "file" or not path.endswith((".yml", ".yaml")):
                    continue
                document = self._document(repository, path, ref)
                files.append(
                    ModelGroupWorkflowFile(
                        repository=repository,
                        path=path,
                        ref=ref,
                        selects_group_label=self._selects(repository, document),
                        triggers=self._triggers(document),
                    )
                )
        return tuple(files)

    def _jobs(
        self,
        repositories: tuple[str, ...],
        files: tuple[ModelGroupWorkflowFile, ...],
    ) -> tuple[ModelGroupJob, ...]:
        selecting = {(f.repository, f.path) for f in files if f.selects_group_label}
        jobs: list[ModelGroupJob] = []
        for repository in repositories:
            for status in _RUN_STATUSES:
                listing = self._get(f"/repos/{repository}/actions/runs?status={status}")
                try:
                    runs = listing["workflow_runs"]
                    for run in runs:
                        path = str(run["path"]).split("@", 1)[0]
                        if (repository, path) not in selecting:
                            continue
                        head = (run.get("head_repository") or {}).get("full_name")
                        run_repository = run.get("repository") or {}
                        base = run_repository.get("full_name")
                        private = run_repository.get("private")
                        jobs.append(
                            ModelGroupJob(
                                run_id=int(run["id"]),
                                run_event=str(run["event"]),
                                head_is_fork=bool(head and base and head != base),
                                workflow_ref=path,
                                repository=str(base) if base else repository,
                                repository_private=(
                                    private if isinstance(private, bool) else None
                                ),
                            )
                        )
                except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError) as error:
                    raise _StopError(EnumExposureReadFailure.UNREADABLE) from error
        return tuple(jobs)

# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
"""HandlerExposureProbe: read one runner group, then ask the compute node for its reading.

EFFECT handler: reads only. The source (in-memory fixture or the GitHub REST API) and every setting
come from the overlay. A group that cannot be read never raises: the compute node reads it UNKNOWN
and the run ends in the typed failure event (``event_for``).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import os
from collections.abc import Mapping
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any
from uuid import NAMESPACE_URL, uuid5

import yaml

from omnimarket.handlers.delegation_scenario_settings import SecretStoreSettingsReader
from omnimarket.models.runner_group_exposure import (

from omnimarket.nodes.node_runner_group_exposure_compute.handlers.handler_runner_group_exposure import (

)
from omnimarket.nodes.node_runner_group_exposure_effect.adapters.github_group_source import (
    GithubGroupSource,
)
from omnimarket.nodes.node_runner_group_exposure_effect.adapters.inmemory_group_source import (
    InMemoryGroupSource,
)
from omnimarket.nodes.node_runner_group_exposure_effect.adapters.write_node_group_reader import (
    WriteNodeGroupReader,
    bus_write_call,
)
from omnimarket.nodes.node_runner_group_exposure_effect.handlers.http_transport import (
    UrllibHttpTransport,
)
from omnimarket.nodes.node_runner_group_exposure_effect.models.model_exposure_probe import (
    ModelExposureProbeRequest,
    ModelExposureProbeResult,
)
from omnimarket.nodes.node_runner_group_exposure_effect.overlay import (
    ModelExposureProbeOverlay,
    ModelInMemorySource,
    load_overlay,
)
from omnimarket.nodes.node_runner_group_exposure_effect.protocols.protocol_group_source import (
    ProtocolGroupSource,
    ProtocolHttpGet,
    ProtocolTokenMint,
)

_CONTRACT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "contract.yaml"


def load_topics() -> dict[str, str]:
    """The topics by role, read from the contract (the handler holds no topic string)."""
    loaded = yaml.safe_load(_CONTRACT.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    return dict(loaded["topics"])


class HandlerExposureProbe:
    def __init__(
        self,
        overlay: ModelExposureProbeOverlay | None = None,
        http_get: ProtocolHttpGet | None = None,
        environ: Mapping[str, str] | None = None,
        token_mint: ProtocolTokenMint | None = None,
        group_reader: WriteNodeGroupReader | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self._group_reader = group_reader
        self._overlay = overlay
        self._http_get = http_get
        self._environ = environ
        self._token_mint = token_mint

    def _source(
        self, overlay: ModelExposureProbeOverlay, correlation_id: str
    ) -> ProtocolGroupSource:
        source = overlay.source
        if isinstance(source, ModelInMemorySource):
            return InMemoryGroupSource(source.fixture)
        token_mint = self._token_mint
        if token_mint is None and source.token_mint is not None:
            store = source.token_mint.store
            token_mint = (
                AppInstallationTokenMint()
                if store is None
                else AppInstallationTokenMint(
                    reader=SecretStoreSettingsReader(overlay=store.secret_store),
                    folder=store.folder,
                )
            )
        environ = os.environ if self._environ is None else self._environ
        group_reader = self._group_reader
        if group_reader is None and source.group_read is not None:
            group_reader = WriteNodeGroupReader(
                source.group_read,
                bus_write_call(route=source.group_read, environ=environ),
            )
        return GithubGroupSource(
            source,
            self._http_get or UrllibHttpTransport(),
            environ,
            token_mint=token_mint,
            group_reader=group_reader,
            # A stable id of this probe, so one read is one bus command.
            correlation_id=uuid5(NAMESPACE_URL, correlation_id),
        )

    def handle(self, request: ModelExposureProbeRequest) -> ModelExposureProbeResult:
        overlay = self._overlay or load_overlay(self._environ)
        read = self._source(overlay, request.correlation_id).read(now=request.now)
        reading = HandlerRunnerGroupExposure().handle(
            ModelRunnerGroupExposureRequest(
                correlation_id=request.correlation_id,
                now=request.now,
                read_at=read.read_at,
                settings=overlay.settings,
                group=read.group,
                files=read.files,
                jobs=read.jobs,
                read_failure=read.read_failure,
            )
        )
        return ModelExposureProbeResult(
            correlation_id=request.correlation_id,
            backend=overlay.source.backend,
            calls=read.calls,
            reading=reading,
            missing_permission=read.missing_permission,
        )

    @staticmethod
    def event_for(result: ModelExposureProbeResult) -> tuple[str, dict[str, Any]]:
        """The terminal event of a run: the failure topic when the group was not read."""
        topics = load_topics()
        topic = (
            topics["probe_failed"]
            if result.reading.read_failure is not None
            else topics["probe_completed"]
        )
        return topic, result.model_dump(mode="json")


__all__ = ["HandlerExposureProbe", "load_topics"]

"""HandlerExposureReadingWriter: run the exposure probe and append one reading row for the run.

EFFECT handler: it writes a reading row and nothing else. A reading is never a gate, a stop or an
admission. A group that cannot be read is an UNKNOWN row (outcome ``source-unreadable``); a
NOT_WORKING verdict that was read is a reading, not a failure; an append that did not land is a

appender run the whole chain with no network and no ledger.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import uuid
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import yaml

from omnimarket.models.model_reading import EnumReadingOutcome
from omnimarket.models.runner_group_exposure import EnumExposureReadFailure
from omnimarket.nodes.node_reading_compute.handlers.handler_reading_compute import (

    HandlerExposureProbe,

from omnimarket.nodes.node_runner_group_exposure_effect.overlay import (
    ModelExposureReadingOverlay,
)

_CONTRACT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "contract.yaml"
_ROW_TYPE = "STATUS"
_ROW_SOURCE_CELL = "src=runner-group-exposure"


def load_reading_topics() -> dict[str, str]:
    """The topics by role, read from the contract (the handler holds no topic string)."""
    return dict(yaml.safe_load(_CONTRACT.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["topics"])


def _sha(text: str) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(text.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()


def _clean(text: str) -> str:
    return " ".join(text.replace("|", "/").split())


class HandlerExposureReadingWriter:
    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        overlay: ModelExposureReadingOverlay,
        host: str,
        probe: HandlerExposureProbe,
        appender: ProtocolReadingAppender | None,
    ) -> None:
        self._overlay = overlay
        self._host = host
        self._probe = probe
        self._appender = appender

    def handle(
        self, request: ModelExposureReadingCommand
    ) -> ModelExposureReadingOutcome:
        overlay = self._overlay
        result = self._probe.handle(
            ModelExposureProbeRequest(
                correlation_id=request.correlation_id, now=request.now
            )
        )
        reading = result.reading
        failure = reading.read_failure
        outcome = (
            EnumReadingOutcome.SOURCE_UNREADABLE
            if failure is not None
            else EnumReadingOutcome.READ
        )
        if failure is None:
            reasons = tuple(
                reason_token(f"{s.name}-{s.reason}")
                for s in reading.subjects
                if s.verdict.value != "WORKING"
            )
        elif failure is EnumExposureReadFailure.ORG_READ_DENIED and (
            result.missing_permission is not None
        ):
            reasons = (
                reason_token(failure.value),
                reason_token("needs-" + result.missing_permission),
            )
        else:
            reasons = (reason_token(failure.value),)
        subject_cells = [f"{s.name}={s.verdict.value}" for s in reading.subjects]
        subject_counts = [
            f"{s.name}_count={s.count}" for s in reading.subjects if s.count is not None
        ]
        overlay_hash = overlay.overlay_hash()
        key = _sha("|".join((self._host, stamp_text(request.now), overlay_hash)))[:32]
        content = _sha(
            json.dumps(
                [
                    reading.verdict.value,
                    outcome.value,
                    list(reasons),
                    subject_cells,
                    subject_counts,
                ],
                sort_keys=True,
            )
        )[:32]

        def done(ledger: str, row: str | None = None) -> ModelExposureReadingOutcome:
            return ModelExposureReadingOutcome(
                correlation_id=request.correlation_id,
                host=self._host,
                backend=result.backend,
                verdict=reading.verdict,
                outcome=outcome,
                reasons=reasons,
                calls=result.calls,
                row_key=key,
                ledger=ledger,
                row=row,
            )

        if not request.write:
            return done("not-written")
        if self._appender is None:
            return done("append-failed:no-appender")
        publish = overlay.publish
        cells = [
            f"lane={publish.lane}",
            _ROW_SOURCE_CELL,
            f"actor={publish.actor}",
            "model=none",
            f"host={self._host}",
            f"backend={result.backend}",
            f"verdict={reading.verdict.value}",
            f"outcome={outcome.value}",
            f"reason={','.join(reasons)}",
            *subject_cells,
            *subject_counts,
            f"calls={result.calls}",
            f"probed_at={stamp_text(request.now)}",
            f"published_at={stamp_text(request.now)}",
            f"max_age={publish.publish_max_age_seconds}",
            f"key={key}",
            f"content={content}",
            f"overlay_hash={overlay_hash[:12]}",
            _clean(f"injected fault: {publish.injected_fault}"),
        ]
        row = f"{stamp_text(request.now)} | {_ROW_TYPE} | " + " | ".join(cells)
        request_id = str(uuid.uuid5(uuid.NAMESPACE_URL, f"{key}|{content}"))
        appended = self._appender.append(row + "\n", request_id)
        if not appended.ok:
            return done(f"append-failed:{appended.status}", row)
        return done(
            "written" if appended.status == "accepted" else "already-written", row
        )

    @staticmethod
    def event_for(
        outcome: ModelExposureReadingOutcome,
    ) -> tuple[str, dict[str, Any]]:
        """The terminal event of a run: the failure topic when it failed."""
        topics = load_reading_topics()
        topic = (
            topics["reading_failed"] if outcome.failed else topics["reading_written"]
        )
        body = outcome.model_dump(mode="json", exclude={"row"})
        return topic, body


__all__ = ["HandlerExposureReadingWriter", "load_reading_topics"]

# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 OmniNode.ai Inc.

"""The overlay of node_runner_group_exposure_effect: every setting of the exposure probe.

Found at ``<root>/node_runner_group_exposure_effect/overlay.yaml`` under a root named in
``ONEX_SKILL_OVERLAY_ROOTS``. The package ships two examples with synthetic values: an in-memory
source (the default way to run it) and a GitHub source. Nothing here has a default: an absent key
refuses the load and names it. The token is never stored: ``token_env`` names the environment
variable that holds it.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
from collections.abc import Mapping
from typing import Annotated, Literal

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field, model_validator

from omnimarket.handlers.node_overlay_reader import load_structured_overlay
from omnimarket.models.runner_group_exposure import (
    EnumExposureReadFailure,
    ModelExposureSettings,
    ModelGroupJob,
    ModelGroupWorkflowFile,
    ModelRunnerGroupFacts,
)
from omnimarket.models.secret_store.model_secret_store_overlay import (
    ModelSecretStoreOverlay,
)
from omnimarket.nodes.node_reading_writer_effect.overlay import ModelLedgerAppendRoute

NODE_NAME = "node_runner_group_exposure_effect"


class ModelInMemoryFixture(BaseModel):
    """The facts one in-memory read returns (or the failure it ends in)."""

    model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True, extra="forbid")

    group: ModelRunnerGroupFacts | None = None
    files: tuple[ModelGroupWorkflowFile, ...] = ()
    jobs: tuple[ModelGroupJob, ...] = ()
    #: How many seconds before the request's ``now`` the fixture was read.
    read_age_seconds: int = Field(ge=0)
    read_failure: EnumExposureReadFailure | None = None


class ModelInMemorySource(BaseModel):
    """The in-memory source: a fixture in the overlay."""

    model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True, extra="forbid")

    backend: Literal["inmemory"]
    fixture: ModelInMemoryFixture


class ModelMintSecretStore(BaseModel):
    """The secret store the App id and key are read from, and the folder that holds both."""

    model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True, extra="forbid")

    #: The store block: addressing and the NAMES of the machine identity's credentials, never a value.
    secret_store: ModelSecretStoreOverlay
    #: The store folder holding the App id and the App private key.
    folder: str = Field(pattern=r"^/")


class ModelTokenMint(BaseModel):
    """The GitHub App the source MINTS an installation token from, once per read.

    Every field is the NAME of a secret-store reference, never a value.
    """

    model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True, extra="forbid")

    #: The org the App is installed on.
    org: str = Field(min_length=1)
    #: The NAME of the secret-store reference holding the App id; never a value.
    app_id_secret: str = Field(min_length=1)
    #: The NAME of the secret-store reference holding the App private key; never a value.
    private_key_secret: str = Field(min_length=1)
    #: Where the two secrets are read from. Null keeps the process environment (or the lane's store);
    #: a block reads them through that store with the machine's identity file and nothing else.
    store: ModelMintSecretStore | None


class ModelWriteNodeGroupRead(BaseModel):
    """Read the runner group through the GitHub write node over the bus, never with the source's own token.

    The write node's App already holds the organization runner permission; its overlay names the
    organization and group id it serves. Every field is a setting, never a credential.
    """

    model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True, extra="forbid")

    #: The bus lane the write node answers on (the lab dev lane).
    bus_lane: str = Field(min_length=1)
    #: The NAME of the environment variable holding the workspace root the bus opener needs.
    workspace_env: str = Field(min_length=1)
    #: A repository of the organization: the write node reads the organization from its owner part.
    anchor_repository: str = Field(pattern=r"^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+$")
    #: The lane name the request carries.
    requested_by_lane: str = Field(min_length=1)
    #: Seconds to wait for the write node's terminal event.
    timeout_seconds: float = Field(gt=0)


class ModelGithubSource(BaseModel):
    """The GitHub source: the REST API, read only."""

    model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True, extra="forbid")

    backend: Literal["github"]
    api_base: str = Field(min_length=1)
    org: str = Field(min_length=1)
    group_id: int
    #: Labels a job's runs-on names to select the group.
    group_labels: tuple[str, ...] = Field(min_length=1)
    #: The NAME of the environment variable holding the read token; the value is never stored.
    #: Read only when ``token_mint`` is null.
    token_env: str = Field(min_length=1)
    #: When set, the source MINTS a fresh installation token once per read instead of reading
    #: ``token_env``; the fields name secret-store references, never values.
    token_mint: ModelTokenMint | None
    #: When set, the runner group's own settings and repositories are read through the write node
    #: over the bus (the organization read the source's own token may not hold); null keeps the
    #: direct read. The workflow and run reads still use the source's token. Absent reads as null,
    #: so an overlay of the main overlays branch written before this key existed still loads; the
    #: deployment's overlay declares the block, and this default is removed once every overlay does.
    group_read: ModelWriteNodeGroupRead | None = None
    #: The NAME of the App permission the organization read of the group needs, named in a
    #: refusal; never a value.
    org_read_permission: str = Field(min_length=1)
    #: Calls one read may make; the call past it is not made.
    max_calls: int = Field(ge=1)
    timeout_seconds: float = Field(gt=0)

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def _group_read_names_the_org(self) -> ModelGithubSource:
        route = self.group_read
        if route is not None:
            owner = route.anchor_repository.split("/", 1)[0]
            if owner.lower() != self.org.lower():
                raise ValueError(
                    "group_read.anchor_repository must belong to the source's org"
                )
        return self


ModelExposureSource = Annotated[
    ModelInMemorySource | ModelGithubSource, Field(discriminator="backend")
]


class ModelExposureProbeOverlay(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True, extra="forbid")

    settings: ModelExposureSettings
    source: ModelExposureSource


def load_overlay(environ: Mapping[str, str] | None = None) -> ModelExposureProbeOverlay:
    return load_structured_overlay(NODE_NAME, ModelExposureProbeOverlay, environ)


class ModelExposurePublish(BaseModel):
    """How a reading row is published: its lane and actor, how long it stays fresh, its fault."""

    model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True, extra="forbid")

    lane: str = Field(min_length=1)
    actor: str = Field(min_length=1)
    #: How long a published reading stays fresh; older, a reader treats it as NOT WORKING.
    publish_max_age_seconds: int = Field(ge=1)
    injected_fault: str = Field(min_length=1)


class ModelExposureHost(BaseModel):
    """A host that runs the hourly schedule: its scheduler, its venv and its unit environment."""

    model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True, extra="forbid")

    name: str = Field(min_length=1)
    scheduler: Literal["systemd-user"]
    #: The venv whose interpreter runs the installed unit, relative to the registry root (or
    #: absolute): a dedicated venv of an installed unit, never a dispatch venv or a worktree.
    venv: str = Field(min_length=1)
    #: An environment file the unit reads when it exists (``EnvironmentFile=-``). The token the
    #: GitHub source names in ``token_env`` is supplied there, never in the overlay or the unit.
    environment_file: str = Field(min_length=1)
    #: Environment the host's installed unit carries (the ledger route and its roots).
    environment: dict[str, str]


class ModelExposureReadingOverlay(ModelExposureProbeOverlay):
    """The probe's overlay plus what the reading writer and the schedule need."""

    ledger_append: ModelLedgerAppendRoute
    publish: ModelExposurePublish
    hosts: tuple[ModelExposureHost, ...]

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def _shape(self) -> ModelExposureReadingOverlay:
        names = [host.name for host in self.hosts]
        if len(names) != len(set(names)):
            raise ValueError("a host is declared twice")
        return self

    def host(self, name: str) -> ModelExposureHost | None:
        return next((host for host in self.hosts if host.name == name), None)

    def overlay_hash(self) -> str:
        """Hash of what the reading depends on, so a settings change shows in the row."""
        text = json.dumps(
            {
                "settings": self.settings.model_dump(mode="json"),
                "source": self.source.model_dump(mode="json", exclude={"fixture"}),
            },
            sort_keys=True,
            separators=(",", ":"),
        )
        return hashlib.sha256(text.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:24]


def load_reading_overlay(
    environ: Mapping[str, str] | None = None,
) -> ModelExposureReadingOverlay:
    return load_structured_overlay(NODE_NAME, ModelExposureReadingOverlay, environ)

    "ModelGithubSource",
    "ModelInMemoryFixture",
    "ModelInMemorySource",
    "ModelMintSecretStore",
    "ModelTokenMint",
    "ModelWriteNodeGroupRead",
    "load_overlay",
    "load_reading_overlay",
]
